name: blueplan
description: Documentation-driven, step-based, TDD-first development workflow: project docs (architecture/PRD/ADR), per-feature step plans executable across sessions, subagent-driven step execution with implementation notes and per-step HTML reports, an HTML test dashboard showing what each test file covers and what it deliberately does not, reference-doc routing, and a read-only permission auditor that reports what the AI can actually read, modify, and destroy.
